Coach

Led by a champion.

Tasman Boxing Club was set up by Amiee Baker — and she knows exactly what it takes, because she’s done it herself.

AMIEE BAKERHead coach · Tasman

“She hits so hard, is fast, very determined — and doing very well.”

Amiee Baker is a former national and Oceania amateur champion in the 66kg division. When she set up Tasman Boxing Club, she brought that experience — and that standard — to a new generation of Nelson boxers.

Her stable is small and focused: five fighters training together, travelling together, and winning together — with the support of Nelson’s wider boxing community behind them.

🏆 National champion 🏆 Oceania champion · 66kg 🥊 5-fighter stable
